subject.title: Dashboard: export / import / share a workspace config

question: Should dashboard workspace export/import/share proceed as a bundled dashboard follow-up after the Wave 1 stack, and what storage/security boundary should imports use?
rationale: The request adds a new user-facing distribution flow over persistent workspace state and potentially untrusted custom widgets; code inspection can prove the gap but cannot choose the product and trust boundary.

options.title: Keep As Dashboard Follow-Up
options.body: Keep this issue open behind the Wave 1 dashboard PRs and require maintainer-approved import/export, validation, rollback, and custom-widget approval semantics before implementation.

options.title: Fold Into General Backup
options.body: Treat workspace export/import as part of the broader browser backup/restore direction if maintainers want one unified state portability surface.

options.title: Defer Or Externalize
options.body: Defer the feature or move it to an external plugin if maintainers decide bundled dashboard distribution is not current product direction.

recommendation.title: Keep As Dashboard Follow-Up
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open behind the Wave 1 dashboard PRs and require maintainer-approved import/export, validation, rollback, and custom-widget approval semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest recent owner signal for the Control UI/plugin-tab product seam this feature builds on.
